originalTitle: The Lord of The Rings: The Dread Of The Monster
overview: In the peaceful Shire, a restless hobbit named Tobin Bramblefoot dreams of a world beyond the familiar hills of his home. When the wizard Gandalf arrives seeking the elusive creature Gollum, Tobin must confront his greatest fear: leaving behind the only life he has ever known.  Journeying into the darkening lands of Middle earth, Tobin and Gandalf uncover the growing influence of Sauron and the terrible secrets surrounding the One Ring. Their pursuit leads them into the corrupted forests of the East, where ancient evils stir, unlikely allies emerge, and the boundaries between hunter and hunted begin to blur. Joined by the Elven warrior Legolas and the ancient Ent Harrowroot, the company faces dangers that threaten far more than their own survival.
tagline: One hunt. One Ring. A shadow rising.
title: The Lord of The Rings: The Dread Of The Monster
